measured_rule: A stage is measured only if its verdict depends on at least one market-derived operand compared with a source predicate and can fail on real data.

operands.name: structure_break
operands.predicate: C1 p.4 structure break of the premarked level
operands.rule: fail if a 1-minute close is more than 8 ticks through the location before the contact

operands.name: new_information
operands.rule: recorded as None; does not drive the verdict

operands.name: origin_ticks
operands.rule: pass if the location ticks exist

operands.name: location_kind
operands.predicate: ABS pp.6-7; F09 never POC or inside balance
operands.rule: pass if kind is source-literal and not inside overnight VA for a mid-range swing

operands.name: release
operands.rule: fail if displacement < 8 ticks or slower than 5s

operands.name: failure
